Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing the financial loss to emergency medical care and transportation services by ensuring direct payment for emergency transportation services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing the financial loss to emergency medicalcare and transportation services by ensuring direct payment foremergency transportation services; and amending RCW 48.44.026.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.44.026 and 1999 c 130 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Checks in payment for claims pursuant to any health care servicecontract for health care services provided by persons licensed orregulated under chapter((s)) 18.25, 18.29, 18.30, 18.32, 18.53, 18.57,18.64, 18.71, 18.73, 18.74, 18.83, or 18.79 RCW, as it applies toregistered nurses and advanced registered nurse practitioners, wherethe provider is not a participating provider under a contract with thehealth care service contractor, shall be made out to both the providerand the enrolled participant with the provider as the first namedpayee, jointly, to require endorsement by each((: PROVIDED, That)).Payment shall be made in the single name of the enrolled participant ifthe enrolled participant as part of his or her claim furnishes clearand convincing evidence ((of prepayment)) that payment has been made to p. 1 SHB 1263the health care service provider((: AND PROVIDED FURTHER, That)).Nothing in this section shall preclude a health care service contractorfrom voluntarily issuing payment in the single name of the provider.
